name: application-breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
description: Landmark navigation trails showing a user's path through a site hierarchy and allowing them to step back to any parent level.
useWhen: Content lives more than one level deep and users frequently need to step back up the hierarchy.
Supplementing a sidebar or top-nav on category, record, or settings drill-down pages.
E-commerce product pages, admin record detail views, and documentation nested sections.
avoidWhen: The site is flat and pages have no meaningful parent–child relationship.
A single back button already satisfies the navigation need.
The breadcrumb would repeat labels already visible in the primary navigation.
responsiveBehavior: Breadcrumbs truncate or collapse intermediate items on small viewports. The current page label and at least one parent should remain visible at all widths.
accessibility: Wrap in a <nav> element with aria-label="Breadcrumb" so screen readers identify the landmark.
Mark the current page item with aria-current="page" and do not make it a link.
Divider characters must be hidden from assistive technology with aria-hidden="true".

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Text links separated by chevron dividers — the simplest breadcrumb pattern for multi-level hierarchies.
accessibility: Wrap in <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> and add aria-current="page" to the last item.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Chevron-divided text breadcrumbs adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark link and divider colors maintain readable contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Base with home icon
variants.description: Breadcrumbs replacing the top-level text label with a recognizable home icon for cleaner root navigation.
accessibility: Home icon link must have an aria-label or visually-hidden text for screen readers.

variants.title: Base with home icon (Dark)
variants.description: Home-icon-prefixed breadcrumbs adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Home icon link must have an aria-label or visually-hidden text for screen readers.

variants.title: Slash divider
variants.description: Breadcrumbs using a slash separator, a common convention in file-path and URL-style hierarchies.
accessibility: Slash dividers must carry aria-hidden="true" to avoid being read aloud.

variants.title: Slash divider (Dark)
variants.description: Slash-separated breadcrumbs adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Slash dividers must carry aria-hidden="true" to avoid being read aloud.

variants.title: Slash divider with home icon
variants.description: Combines a home icon root with slash dividers between subsequent levels for a compact, file-path style trail.
accessibility: Home icon link needs an aria-label; slash dividers use aria-hidden.

variants.title: Slash divider with home icon (Dark)
variants.description: Home-icon-root slash breadcrumbs adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Home icon link needs an aria-label; slash dividers use aria-hidden.

variants.title: Grouped with chevron divider
variants.description: Breadcrumbs enclosed in a pill-shaped container, visually grouping the trail as a distinct navigational unit.
accessibility: The pill container is decorative; landmark semantics come from the inner <nav> element.

variants.title: Grouped with chevron divider (Dark)
variants.description: Pill-contained chevron breadcrumbs adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: The pill container is decorative; landmark semantics come from the inner <nav> element.
